card.name: Volumes and counts in dose preparation
card.fires_on: Numbers (and the word volume or mL) that give how much liquid to draw up, add or give, or how many units or times, in dose-preparation instructions.

modes.label: Digits in volumes
modes.description: A digit inside an amount of liquid to withdraw or add, just before mL.
modes.example: For a 300 mg dose, add 1<<0>> mL of FERABRIGHT to

modes.label: Volume or mL word
modes.description: The word volume or the unit mL right after a dose amount in administration steps.
modes.example: withdraw 4<< mL>> of the reconstituted solution from

modes.label: Count of items or repeats
modes.description: A number saying how many pre-filled syringes or times something is done.
